name: Dülmen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, with a blue cross with trefoiled ends on the yellow towards the hoist, taken from the city arms of Dülmen.
history: The city of Dülmen was most recently granted the right to bear arms, a seal, a banner and a flag by deed of the Regierungspräsident in Münster of 19 July 1977; the banner is yellow and blue striped lengthwise 1:1 with the cross in the upper half of the yellow stripe.

features.role: cross with trefoiled ends from the city arms
